items.q: Players who fail to ______ by the anti-doping code face an automatic two-year suspension.
items.vi: Những vận động viên không tuân thủ bộ quy tắc chống doping sẽ bị treo giò tự động hai năm.
items.explanation: Only abide takes the preposition by already in the sentence (abide by a rule = follow it). ✗ observe — observe a code takes a direct object, no by; ✗ obey — obey the code, also a direct object; ✗ conform — needs to (conform to the code), not by.

items.q: The minister's proposal to ban foreign words from state broadcasts ______ in parliament, with members of her own party voting against it.
items.vi: Đề xuất cấm từ ngoại lai trên đài phát thanh nhà nước của bà bộ trưởng đã thất bại thảm hại ở quốc hội, khi chính các nghị sĩ đảng bà bỏ phiếu chống.
items.explanation: Go down in flames = fail spectacularly and publicly — the clue is her own party voting against it. ✗ went through the roof — rose sharply (prices, tempers); ✗ went off the rails — lost control, went badly wrong (a person, a plan); ✗ went under the hammer — was sold at auction.

items.q: The bill ______ by the president twice before a revised version finally became law.
items.vi: Dự luật đã bị tổng thống phủ quyết hai lần trước khi phiên bản sửa đổi cuối cùng trở thành luật.
items.explanation: The bill receives the action, so the passive is needed, and the vetoes happened before a past event (before … became law): past perfect passive had been vetoed. ✗ was vetoing — active, the bill would be doing the vetoing; ✗ had vetoed — active too, but by the president shows the bill is the object; ✗ has been vetoed — present perfect links to now, but the whole sequence is in the past.

items.q: Having promised deep tax cuts, the opposition cruised to a ______ victory in the general election.
items.vi: Sau khi hứa cắt giảm mạnh thuế, phe đối lập đã giành chiến thắng áp đảo trong cuộc tổng tuyển cử.
items.explanation: Landslide victory is the fixed collocation for winning by a huge margin — the clue is cruised to, an easy win. ✗ avalanche — a snow slide; figuratively only a flood of things (an avalanche of complaints); ✗ earthquake — a shock or upheaval, not a margin of victory; ✗ mudslide — purely literal, never pairs with victory.

items.q: Campaigners who try to replace legal jargon with plain English soon ______ centuries of professional tradition.
items.vi: Những người vận động thay thế thuật ngữ pháp lý bằng tiếng Anh giản dị sớm vấp phải truyền thống nghề nghiệp hàng thế kỷ.
items.explanation: Come up against = meet an obstacle or opposition — centuries of professional tradition is what blocks them. ✗ come round to — gradually accept an idea; ✗ come in for — receive (criticism, praise); ✗ come down with — fall ill with (flu, a cold).

items.q: The assistant referee ______ his flag so hastily: the replay showed the striker was a yard onside.
items.vi: Trợ lý trọng tài lẽ ra không cần phất cờ vội vàng đến thế: pha quay chậm cho thấy tiền đạo đã đứng trên việt vị cả mét.
items.explanation: Needn't have + past participle = he did it, but it was unnecessary — he did raise the flag (so hastily), and the replay shows it was pointless. ✗ can't have raised — deduction that he did not raise it, but he did; ✗ mustn't have raised — also a deduction that he didn't do it (and not used for past deduction in British English); ✗ might not have raised — doubt about whether he raised it, but we know he did.

items.q: To encourage younger competitors, the federation agreed to ______ the entry fee for athletes under eighteen.
items.vi: Để khuyến khích các vận động viên trẻ, liên đoàn đồng ý miễn lệ phí đăng ký cho những người dưới mười tám tuổi.
items.explanation: Waive = choose not to demand a fee or right you are entitled to — the clue is the entry fee. ✗ revoke — officially take back a licence or permission; ✗ repeal — cancel a law; ✗ annul — declare a marriage or contract invalid.

items.q: ______ has a scientific paper attracted so much public attention as the study linking teenagers' screen time to loss of sleep.
items.vi: Hiếm khi một bài báo khoa học lại thu hút nhiều sự chú ý của công chúng đến thế như nghiên cứu liên hệ thời gian dùng màn hình của thanh thiếu niên với tình trạng mất ngủ.
items.explanation: A fronted negative adverb forces subject–verb inversion (has a scientific paper attracted), and Rarely pairs with so much … as. ✗ Not until — needs a time expression first (Not until 2020 has …); ✗ Only when — needs a full clause before the inverted part; ✗ Little — inverts only with verbs of knowing (Little did they realise), not with attract.

items.q: Rather than argue with the coaching staff, the young striker decided to ______ and accept his new role on the wing.
items.vi: Thay vì tranh cãi với ban huấn luyện, tiền đạo trẻ quyết định thuận theo tình hình và chấp nhận vai trò mới ở biên.
items.explanation: Go with the flow = accept what is happening without resisting — the clue is rather than argue … accept his new role. ✗ go by the book — follow the rules strictly; ✗ go against the grain — do what feels unnatural, the opposite of normal; ✗ go the extra mile — make extra effort.

items.q: Once the chair had ______ with the roll call, the committee ______ straight to the vote.
items.vi: Sau khi chủ tọa bỏ qua thủ tục điểm danh, ủy ban chuyển thẳng sang bỏ phiếu.
items.explanation: Dispense with = do without, skip (the roll call), and proceed to = move on to (the vote). ✗ disposed / preceded — dispose of = throw away, and precede = come before; ✗ dispensed / preceded — precede takes a direct object (precede the vote) and means come before, not move on; ✗ disposed / proceeded — dispose takes of, not with, and means get rid of.

items.q: Anti-corruption laws are only as effective as the authorities' willingness to ______ them.
items.vi: Luật chống tham nhũng chỉ hiệu quả ngang với mức độ sẵn sàng thực thi chúng của nhà chức trách.
items.explanation: Enforce = make people obey a law that already exists — the laws are already in place, so the question is whether they are applied. ✗ enact — pass a law, make it official; ✗ ratify — formally approve a treaty or agreement; ✗ legislate — make laws, and it does not take them as an object (legislate on/for).

items.q: Neither the head coach nor the players ______ willing to comment on the leaked dressing-room footage.
items.vi: Cả huấn luyện viên trưởng lẫn các cầu thủ đều không muốn bình luận về đoạn phim phòng thay đồ bị rò rỉ.
items.explanation: With neither … nor the verb agrees with the nearer subject, the plural players, so were. ✗ was — singular, would only agree with the further subject coach; ✗ is — singular, the nearer subject is plural; ✗ has been — singular as well.

items.q: The new commissioner has promised ______ reforms of the way doping cases are investigated.
items.vi: Tân cao ủy hứa hẹn những cải cách sâu rộng về cách điều tra các vụ doping.
items.explanation: Sweeping reforms/changes = wide-ranging, affecting everything — the fixed collocation with reforms. ✗ brushing — light touching or cleaning, no figurative use; ✗ wiping — cleaning a surface (wipe out is a different idiom); ✗ mopping — cleaning a floor (mop up = finish off), never used with reforms.

items.q: It only ______ the commentators afterwards that the referee had misapplied the offside rule.
items.vi: Mãi sau đó các bình luận viên mới nhận ra rằng trọng tài đã áp dụng sai luật việt vị.
items.explanation: It dawns on someone that = they gradually realise — the clue is the empty-it pattern It only … afterwards that. ✗ dwelt on — kept thinking or talking about, and needs a person as subject; ✗ hit on — suddenly thought of (an idea), person as subject; ✗ touched on — mentioned briefly, person as subject.

items.q: ______ the referee's lengthy explanation, the home fans remained convinced they had been robbed.
items.vi: Bất chấp lời giải thích dài dòng của trọng tài, cổ động viên chủ nhà vẫn tin chắc họ đã bị cướp mất chiến thắng.
items.explanation: A noun phrase follows (the referee's lengthy explanation), so a preposition is needed: Notwithstanding = despite. ✗ Nevertheless — an adverb that links two sentences, cannot govern a noun; ✗ Although — a conjunction, needs a subject and verb; ✗ Whereas — also needs a clause, and contrasts two facts rather than conceding one.

items.q: With two minutes left and the champions a goal down, their unbeaten record was ______.
items.vi: Còn hai phút, đội đương kim vô địch đang bị dẫn một bàn, thành tích bất bại của họ đang treo trên sợi tóc.
items.explanation: Hang by a thread = be in a very precarious position — the clue is two minutes left … a goal down. ✗ hanging in the air — left unresolved, unanswered; ✗ hanging out to dry — abandoned to take the blame; ✗ hanging on every word — listening eagerly to a speaker.

items.q: It is high time the federation ______ its outdated rules on which nationality an athlete may represent.
items.vi: Đã đến lúc liên đoàn phải sửa đổi các quy định lỗi thời về việc vận động viên được đại diện cho quốc tịch nào.
items.explanation: It is high time is followed by a past-tense form with present meaning (unreal past): revised. ✗ revise — bare form; that would follow it is time for the federation to; ✗ revises — present simple is not used after it is (high) time; ✗ has revised — present perfect, wrong form for this structure.

items.q: Broadcasting the interview before the trial would ______ the reporting restrictions imposed by the court.
items.vi: Phát sóng cuộc phỏng vấn trước phiên tòa sẽ vi phạm các hạn chế đưa tin do tòa án áp đặt.
items.explanation: Contravene = act against a rule or law, and it takes a direct object (the reporting restrictions). ✗ offend — needs against (offend against the rules), or means upset a person; ✗ trespass — needs on/against (trespass on land); ✗ overrule — reverse a decision, which only a higher court can do, not a broadcaster.

items.q: The more technical the wording of a contract, ______ an ordinary citizen is to understand it.
items.vi: Câu chữ hợp đồng càng chuyên môn thì người dân bình thường càng ít có khả năng hiểu được nó.
items.explanation: The double comparative the more …, the less … needs the in both halves, and The more technical sets the pattern. ✗ less likely — missing the; ✗ the least likely — superlative, not a comparative; ✗ the less likelier — likelier is already comparative, so less makes a double comparative.

items.q: The club has ______ an appeal against the six-point deduction with the league's independent panel.
items.vi: Câu lạc bộ đã nộp đơn kháng cáo lên hội đồng độc lập của giải đấu phản đối việc bị trừ sáu điểm.
items.explanation: Lodge an appeal/complaint is the fixed legal collocation for formally submitting one, matched by with the … panel. ✗ placed — place an order/bet, not an appeal; ✗ put — only works as put in an appeal, and in is missing; ✗ laid — lay charges/blame, not an appeal.

items.q: The party leader is reported ______ the coalition offer at a private meeting late last night.
items.vi: Lãnh đạo đảng được cho là đã bác bỏ đề nghị liên minh tại một cuộc gặp riêng khuya qua.
items.explanation: After be reported/said/believed, an action earlier than the report takes the perfect infinitive: to have rejected — the clue is late last night. ✗ to reject — present or future action, clashes with last night; ✗ rejecting — this passive pattern takes a to-infinitive, not -ing; ✗ having rejected — perfect -ing form, again not the pattern after is reported.

items.q: The press officer ______ fielding calls from reporters once the memo had been leaked.
options: had her heart in her mouth
had her feet on the ground
items.vi: Nữ cán bộ báo chí bận tối mắt tối mũi trả lời các cuộc gọi từ phóng viên khi bản ghi nhớ bị rò rỉ.
items.explanation: Have your hands full = be extremely busy — the clue is fielding calls nonstop. ✗ had her hands tied — was unable to act; ✗ had her heart in her mouth — was very nervous; ✗ had her feet on the ground — was sensible and realistic.

items.q: ______ in plain English rather than legal jargon, the new tenancy agreement can be understood without a lawyer.
items.vi: Được viết bằng tiếng Anh giản dị thay vì thuật ngữ pháp lý, hợp đồng thuê nhà mới có thể hiểu được mà không cần luật sư.
items.explanation: The agreement is written by someone, so the reduced clause is passive: past participle Written (= Because it is written …). ✗ Writing — active, would make the agreement the writer; ✗ Having written — active perfect, same problem; ✗ To write — infinitive of purpose, does not describe the agreement.

items.q: The High Court ______ the conviction after new evidence showed the confession had been obtained under duress.
items.vi: Tòa án Tối cao đã hủy bản án sau khi bằng chứng mới cho thấy lời thú tội được lấy dưới sự cưỡng ép.
items.explanation: Quash is the legal verb for officially cancelling a conviction or decision — the clue is the High Court … the conviction. ✗ squashed — flattened; informally only suppressed (a rumour); ✗ crushed — physically broken or defeated (crush a rebellion); ✗ smashed — broken into pieces.

items.q: Small clubs and wealthy giants alike are ______ the same ______ when it comes to the new salary cap.
items.vi: Các câu lạc bộ nhỏ lẫn các đại gia giàu có đều cùng chung cảnh ngộ khi nói đến mức trần lương mới.
items.explanation: In the same boat = in the same difficult situation — the clue is alike … the same. ✗ on / ship — wrong preposition and wrong noun; ✗ in / ship — the idiom is fixed with boat, not ship; ✗ on / boat — on a boat is literal; the idiom takes in.
